phases.name: Owner Cellular Voice Gateway Program Charter
Full Conversation Context Archive Design
phases.owner_action: Approve the proposed retention, archive, and privacy policy after AI validation.

phases.name: Gateway Threat Model
phases.owner_action: Accept or reject the documented residual gateway risks after mitigations are presented.

phases.name: Phone Number Routing Model
phases.owner_action: Confirm ownership/control of the selected phone number and provider account without placing credentials in the repository.

phases.name: Z Fold 6 Trusted Command Terminal Model
phases.owner_action: Physically enroll and approve the trusted command device using the provider or operating-system security flow.

phases.name: Voice Recognition Confidence Model
phases.owner_action: Approve the tested voice-confidence threshold and rejection policy.

phases.name: Sick-Day and Voice Fallback Model
phases.owner_action: Approve the fallback and lockout policy used when voice confidence is insufficient.

phases.name: Anti-Replay and Time-Bound Liveness Model
phases.owner_action: Approve the tested liveness window and replay-rejection policy.

phases.name: YubiKey and Passkey Authority Model
phases.owner_action: Physically enroll the approved YubiKey/passkeys and confirm possession; private keys and recovery secrets must never enter the repository.

phases.name: Governance Memory Model
phases.owner_action: Approve what authority decisions may be remembered and their retention/expiry rules.

phases.name: Risk-Scored Command Gating Model
phases.owner_action: Approve the tested command-risk thresholds that determine when owner authority is required.

phases.name: Runtime Bridge Architecture
phases.owner_action: Authorize activation of the validated runtime bridge only after deployment evidence is presented.

phases.name: The_Lab Execution Routing
phases.owner_action: Approve the final execution authority boundary for The_Lab after the route is proven fail-closed.

phases.name: Vault, Secrets, and Session Protection
phases.owner_action: Perform or authorize required vault/session configuration in the protected external system; no secret values may be stored in the repository.

phases.name: Location Vault and Privacy Broker
phases.owner_action: Give explicit location/privacy consent for the final validated scope before any location capability is activated.
